title: The Episode About Wazir Khan's Murder

blocks.text: Banda remains seated high while the battle rages below, and Wazir Khan ordered a gunner to blow him apart, assuming that one accurate strike will end the whole struggle.
Instead, the attack misfires into spectacle: Banda mounts up, releases an arrow, and a confusion of dust and blindness spreads through the Mughal side until they begin harming one another.
This page uses artillery, elevation, and misperception to turn apparent Mughal advantage into fear and disarray.
